facts.fact: Parakou municipal officials named formalising land transactions through e-Foncier Bénin and adding platform functions for recasement attestations, mutation certificates and compulsions as next steps (reported by Matin Libre).
Fraternité states that with the cadastre registration certificate a parcel can be sold legally at the mairie and that all operations are done directly in e-Foncier Bénin.

La Nation reports that the e-Foncier platform has been operational since 1 January 2025 with mairies, notaries and surveyors, and that nine e-Services on service-public.bj included 163 property transfer requests and mortgage registration, with 11,418 online requests from May 2022 to December 2024 (ANDF).

note: Reports parcel registration and certificate distribution in Porto-Novo; no transaction processing, survey-map or valuation join, or tax link stated.
Reports Parakou parcel counts and certificate distribution on e-Foncier Bénin; no electronic transaction processing, survey-map or valuation join, or tax link stated.

facts.fact: ANDF's PPMEC II project chief said the e-Foncier Bénin platform has functions to register parcels, issue cadastral registration certificates and update records, with 643,993 parcels registered in 12 communes.
Benin's government says the TERRA BENIN and PPMEC II projects launched on 6 November 2026 will develop and improve the e-Foncier Benin platform; no transactions processed on it are stated.

ANDF's information systems director Alidou Saré says the E-TERRE platform manages the process of issuing land titles and related administrative procedures, and is connected to the National Public Services Portal, for parcels whose registration is already under way.

systems.owner: Agence Nationale du Domaine et du Foncier (ANDF)
Agence Nationale du Domaine et du Foncier (ANDF)

note: E-TERRE and e-Foncier are not stated as joined to each other, and no tax link is stated.

facts.fact: MDF, the implementer, says that e-Foncier Benin, built with ANDF since 2018, records land rights, with 222,463 people holding recorded rights and 2 municipalities and 387 villages almost fully registered between 2021 and 2025.
MDF says e-Foncier Benin is a digital system that maps plot boundaries and links them to legal records, with 491,293 parcels mapped in 2021-2025.

systems.owner: ANDF (Agence Nationale du Domaine et du Foncier)

note: The e-foncier platform is named only as a platform whose users' responsibility the new decree clarifies; processing of land transactions is not stated.
